adds.title: Mulher trans é assassinada dentro de casa em Mossoró; cinco são suspeitos
adds.summary: Saiba Mais (RN) reports that in the early hours of 4 May 2026 a 27-year-old transgender woman, Emanuelle Samira Fernandes Neta, was shot dead inside her rented home on Rua Vivaldo Dantas in the Dom Jaime Câmara neighbourhood of Mossoró, western Rio Grande do Norte, after five men broke in and executed her while she slept; military police found the body on a routine patrol, and one suspect was arrested with a pistol and booked for illegal firearms discharge and armed criminal association. RN trans-rights group ATTRANSPARÊNCIA/RN publicly mourned Samira as an artist killed by the transphobia she faced. The case documents lethal violence against trans women in Rio Grande do Norte continuing after the years this record covers, matching the record's warning that a single-year zero should not be read as safety.

adds.title: Mulher trans é encontrada morta dentro de casa na Praia da Pipa; Civil investiga o caso
adds.summary: Saiba Mais (RN) reports that a transgender woman known as Naomi was found dead inside her own home in Praia da Pipa, Tibau do Sul municipality on the southern coast of Rio Grande do Norte, killed by stab wounds in late February 2026, with the Civil Police opening an investigation and RN trans-rights association ATTRANSPARÊNCIA/RN calling for justice. The same article reproduces the ANTRA 2025 dossier figures: 80 trans killings in Brazil in 2025 (a 34% drop from 2024), 38 of them in the Nordeste, and zero registered trans killings in Rio Grande do Norte in 2025 — a count that conflicts with this record's stated 4 killings for the state in 2025 and needs reconciliation in rework.
